The round was led by Dragonfly, with participation from Accel, Gradient, Coinbase Ventures, Operator Collective, Formus Capital, and VanEck Ventures, alongside continued support from existing investors including Okta Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Anthropic, and Array Ventures. The Series A comes six months after Sapiom's $15 million seed round and just 11 months after the company was founded, bringing total funding to $50 million.

hits.snippet: **[Sapiom](https://sapiom.ai/)** , a San Francisco, CA-based provider of a platform that specializes in AI agents management, raised $35M in Series A financing. The round was led by Dragonfly with participation from Accel, Gradient, Coinbase Ventures, Operator Collective, Formus Capital, and VanEck Ventures, as well as existing investors Okta Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Anthropic, and Array Ventures. hits.snippet: Sapiom Raises $35 Million Series A To Scale AI Agent Infrastructure Sapiom has raised $35 million in Series A funding to expand its infrastructure platform for deploying, operating and scaling artificial intelligence agents. Dragonfly led the round, with participation from Accel, Gradient, Coinbase Ventures, Operator Collective, Formus Capital and VanEck Ventures. Existing investors Okta Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Anthropic and Array Ventures also participated. The financing follows Sapiom's $15 million seed round completed six months earlier and brings the company's total funding to $50 million less than a year after its founding. ...
